ModMetaData.name: Gear Seed Demo (PirateWaster)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description: Demo content for Faction Gear Seeder (pas.gear.community): a single FactionGearSeedDef for the PirateWaster faction, transcribed from a yc's Faction Editor preset with tools/transcribe_yc_preset.py. Pure data — no C#. Enable this together with the Faction Gear Seeder engine and Harmony to see PirateWaster pawns spawn wearing and wielding the transcribed loadout.\n\nThis is the third layer of the opening-world pipeline demo (roster / relations / gear).
